# The Healing Home

> A mindful architectural design and home renovation practice integrating biophilic design, sustainable materials, and wellness principles to create healing home environments.

The Healing Home, led by Elena Morrison (LEED AP, Master's in Sustainable Design), specializes in holistic home design that combines environmental psychology, feng shui, sacred geometry, and sustainable building practices. The practice focuses on creating spaces that promote physical wellness and emotional harmony through intentional architectural and design choices.

## Key Topics

- Biophilic Design
- Sustainable Materials
- Feng Shui

- Energy Flow

## Design Principles & Guides

- [The Power of Biophilic Design: Bringing Nature Home - The Healing Home](https://thehealinghome.me/articles/biophilic-design-principles.html): Article on biophilic design principles and benefits of integrating nature into homes.
- [Sustainable Materials: A Complete Guide for Conscious Renovators - The Healing Home](https://thehealinghome.me/articles/sustainable-materials-guide.html): Comprehensive guide to eco-friendly materials including reclaimed wood and VOC-free finishes.
- [Creating Flow: Energy Patterns in Home Design - The Healing Home](https://thehealinghome.me/articles/energy-flow-home-design.html): Article on feng shui, spatial design, and energy flow optimization in home spaces.
